dict.string: Piwin uses the camera to scan a Host pairing QR code and to attach photos to a chat.
Piwin uses the microphone while you hold the mic button to dictate a message.
Piwin converts your held speech into text on this device, then sends that text to your Host.
Piwin reads the Apple Health categories you select and sends those summaries to your configured Piwin Host for chat analysis. Piwin never writes to Apple Health.
